metadata.title: Groupicorn Pennsylvania IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. This initial Pennsylvania pass covers Philadelphia and the Delaware Valley, Reading, the Lehigh Valley and Poconos, Harrisburg/Lancaster, Pittsburgh, and Altoona. Shortlists use distinct provider groups, local-first ordering, and explicit neighbor labels; they are not clinical rankings.
metadata.branding_note: logo_url points to a locally stored PNG acquired from an official provider-controlled source. License clearance is not implied.
metadata.geocoding_note: Street addresses and ZIP codes are stored; coordinates are intentionally null pending an audited geocoding pass.
metadata.publication_warning: Verify current program availability, age/track eligibility, insurance, intake requirements, and accepting-patient status before public display or referral use. Telehealth offerings are not counted as physical locations.
